earnings.title: Linsey Wisniewski
highlights: GAAP Net Income of $5.19 per share and Adjusted (non-GAAP) Operating Earnings of $5.06 per share for the third quarter of 2026
Our GAAP Net Income for the third quarter of 2026 increased to $5.19 per share from $2.97 per share in the third quarter of 2025.
GAAP Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Common Shareholders $ 1,835 $ 5.19 $ 930 $ 2.97
Earnings per share amount is based on average diluted common shares outstanding of 354 million and 313 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively.

quotes.text: This past quarter Constellation announced agreements that are helping meet one of the nation’s greatest challenges – powering a growing economy while protecting existing customers.
quotes.by: Joe Dominguez, chairman, president and chief executive officer of Constellation

quotes.text: Third quarter adjusted operating earnings were $5.06 per share, compared with $3.04 a year ago. This strong performance allowed us to raise the midpoint of our adjusted operating earnings guidance range for the second time this year.
quotes.by: Shane Smith, executive vice president and chief financial officer of Constellation

outlook: Raising midpoint and narrowing full-year Adjusted (non-GAAP) Operating Earnings guidance range to $12.50 - $12.80 per share
